editorial.blurb: Gyu-Kaku serves expertly prepared Japanese tabletop BBQ with flavorful meats and sides, though consistency in execution and service attention can vary.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation online if you arrive without one—walk-ins may face long waits. Request knowledgeable servers like Olivia, Freddie, or Enzo who excel at pacing courses and explaining menu items.
